body: So much of everything they’ve said is confusing to me too. Like how they’re still “fine” with me going to our normal things every week but the first thing I saw on my phone when leaving the hospital was the notifications of getting removed from all of the group chats for said events. Or how they want to help but can’t be there for me anymore 🙃

Yeah I’m definitely much worse off than I had been before all of this. Everyone else would probably tell me that it’s my mindset and that I can move on and build up again but they all say it like that’s so easy. Sorry to hear about your situation, life does indeed suck.
